name: @oh-my-pi/omp-studio-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for OMP Studio
author: Can Boluk

scripts.dist: bun run build:server && bun run build:app && electron-builder
scripts.dist:linux: bun run build:server -- --platform=linux && bun run build:app && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:mac: bun run build:server -- --platform=darwin && bun run build:app && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: bun run build:server -- --platform=win32 && bun run build:app && electron-builder --win
